source: Metrica sample-data (3 matches): missing-ball rate per game state, in-play gap lengths, ball-motion profile targets; track presence and cuts drawn per seed from wide a priori ranges (not fitted).
source_degradation: mean_dropout and min_piece chosen on the 7 IDSSE matches (leave-one-match-out, mean span-F1 'aligned', rule fixed beforehand: best mean wins, no significance threshold; scores in configs/degradation_selection.json)
b_source: median over the 7 IDSSE folds (decoded share of D = true share of D), search interval widened until no fold sits on a bound
